$comment: Legal terms and their approved ta/kn renderings (stems, so inflected forms match). status: needs-lawyer-review until a native-speaking advocate confirms; then reviewed. See docs/engineering/i18n.md.

terms.note: The date a matter is next posted to. Courts in both states also say 'next date' in English.
A matter appearing on a cause list for a day.
A court order, not a purchase order.
Kannada keeps the English term transliterated, as used at the Karnataka High Court; confirm or switch to Latin script with a gloss.
The judge or judges hearing a matter.
Court hall number. Bar usage is often 'court hall' in English; confirm the vernacular reads naturally.
A case handled by the chamber.
A listed hearing; not an investigation.
A junior advocate in a chamber.
The advocate's clerk, not a court officer.
The prepared brief sheet for a hearing. 'Summary' may read too generic; confirm.
Limitation period under the Limitation Act.
A follow-up duty arising from an order or listing.
